attrs.evidence: Six explicit federations separate all ten pairs. The round-3 research witness printed "magnitudes shown pairwise distinct" while its code compared six hand-listed pairs out of ten, and on its five examples the impure-component count and the minimum-purifying-deletion count are NEVER different. GPT-5.6 caught it and proposed the missing witness: K₄ with one site on a perfect matching has ONE impure component (K₄ is 2-connected, so one block) and needs TWO deletions, because K₄ minus any single edge is still 2-connected and still mixed. That witness is added and all ten pairs are now compared programmatically rather than listed.

attrs.statement: The five candidate κₛ magnitudes are pairwise distinct: for each of the ten unordered pairs there is a federation on which they differ.
